title: A Weekend in London
subtitle: Laboratorio: past simple y phrasal verbs

content.instructions: Completa con el past simple del verbo entre paréntesis. Si hay un pronombre, ponlo en su sitio.

items.text: Last Saturday Lucía, Priya and Daniel ___ (take) the train to London. They ___ (get up) at six, so they ___ (be) very sleepy.
items.hint: Take → took, get → got. They + was/were?

items.text: In Camden, Lucía ___ (try / it / on) a vintage jacket, but she ___ (not / buy) it. Daniel ___ (find out) that the market ___ (close) at six.
items.hint: Con pronombre: tried it on. Negativa: didn't + infinitivo.
items.explanation: Try on es separable: el pronombre va en medio (tried it on).

items.text: "___ (you / enjoy) the trip?" Sam ___ (ask) on Sunday night. "Yes! But we ___ (spend) too much money," Lucía ___ (say).
items.hint: Pregunta: did + sujeto + infinitivo. Spend → spent, say → said.

vocabulary.definition: old, but good quality and fashionable
